import MilneLib.FunctionField
import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientIntegral
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientFunctionField

/-!
# Function fields of geometric quotients

For an affine geometric quotient of an integral scheme by a finite group,
pullback gives a Galois extension of the actual scheme function fields.
The invariant-section condition on a nonempty affine open supplies the ring
extension, and germ naturality identifies its fraction-field map with pullback.
This gives the integral-source separability step in Milne III.3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
  {act : G →* Aut X} {q : X ⟶ Y} (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)

include act q hq

/-- Pullback along an affine finite-group geometric quotient of integral
schemes induces a Galois extension of their function fields. -/
theorem functionField_isGalois [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [IsAffineHom q]
    (hgen : q.base (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y) :
    letI := (MilneLib.functionFieldMap q hgen).hom.toAlgebra
    IsGalois Y.functionField X.functionField := by
  letI := (MilneLib.functionFieldMap q hgen).hom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hηU, _⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
    (show genericPoint Y ∈ (⊤ : Y.Opens) from trivial)
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨genericPoint Y, hηU⟩⟩
  have hηpre : genericPoint X ∈ q ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    change q.base (genericPoint X) ∈ U
    rw [hgen]
    exact hηU
  letI : Nonempty (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, hηpre⟩⟩
  let R := Γ(Y, U)
  let A := Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  let hstable := isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hstable
  letI : Algebra R A := (q.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap A X.functionField).comp (q.app U).hom).toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower R A X.functionField := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  letI : IsScalarTower R Y.functionField X.functionField := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro s
    exact (MilneLib.functionFieldMap_germ q hgen U hηU hηpre s).symm
  letI : IsFractionRing R Y.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y U hU
  letI : IsFractionRing A X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hU.preimage q)
  letI : SMulCommClass G R A := ⟨fun g r a => by
    have hfixed : g • (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap R A r := by
      change (actApp act hstable g⁻¹).hom ((q.app U).hom r) = (q.app U).hom r
      exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom r) (app_actApp_of_invariant act q hq.invariant U g⁻¹)
    change g • (algebraMap R A r * a) = algebraMap R A r * (g • a)
    rw [smul_mul', hfixed]⟩
  letI : Algebra.IsInvariant R A G := ⟨fun a ha => by
    apply (hq.mem_range_app U a).mpr
    intro g
    have hg := ha g⁻¹
    change (actApp act hstable (g⁻¹)⁻¹).hom a = a at hg
    simpa only [inv_inv] using hg⟩
  exact invariant_isGalois_of_isFractionRing (k := R) (A := A) (G := G)
    Y.functionField X.functionField

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient
